purpose: Pre-register the ARN v4 relational-correspondence reducer BEFORE touching any confirmatory data. All parameters and thresholds are frozen. Hard falsifier ordering: B3 (shuffled gold) runs FIRST.

parent_v3_attribution.deficit: flat typed-role/relation features insufficient; missing second-order relation-triple structure
parent_v3_attribution.lever: M1 Progressive Relational Abstraction parent: align RELATION TRIPLES (source relation ↔ target relation with role-type consistency)

successor_description: ARN v4 reducer with relational-correspondence scoring (M1 parent). NO language model, NO network, deterministic rules only. Scoring aligns relation triples with role-type consistency, capturing second-order structure.
author: RAKL programme (same-context; LLM-assisted)

extraction.description: Reuse v3 extraction verbatim: typed roles, typed relations, negation scope. All v3 extraction parameters preserved.

mapping.description: Second-order relation-triple alignment. Each query relation forms a triple (source-role-type, relation-type, target-role-type) and matches to candidate relation triples. This captures structural correspondence beyond flat token/type matching.

parent_assimilation.assimilation_principle: Align RELATION TRIPLES (source relation ↔ target relation with role-type consistency), not flat typed-role/relation features.
parent_assimilation.second_order_structure: Relation triples capture the pattern of how relations connect typed roles, which is the analogical structure missing in v3.

relation_triple.example: (SUBJ, CAUSAL, OBJ) represents 'subject CAUSES object' structure

triple_correspondence.exact_match: 1.0 — all three components match exactly (source_role_type == source_role_type AND relation_type == relation_type AND target_role_type == target_role_type)
triple_correspondence.partial_match: 0.5 — relation_type matches AND at least one role_type matches (capturing shared relational structure)

scoring_formula.triple_score: (sum over query triples of best-match correspondence) / |query_triples|
scoring_formula.role_boost: 0.1 * (exact token matches between query and candidate roles) / |query_roles| — additive boost for lexical overlap on top of structural triple score
scoring_formula.combined: score = 0.8 * triple_score + 0.2 * role_boost (weighted toward structural correspondence, lexical signal as secondary)

instance_paired_preservation.description: Every score term consumes the joint (query-triple, candidate-triple) assignment. Shuffling candidate labels breaks triple alignments and collapses advantage BY CONSTRUCTION.
instance_paired_preservation.verification: For any triple correspondence score s, there exists no way to compute s from query alone or candidate alone — requires the joint matching.

mapping.theta_w_fit: DEV grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.05, maximize decidable exact accuracy (same as parent)
mapping.acceptance_rule: ACCEPT iff score >= theta_w, else REJECT

CANNOT_CHECK_conditions.rule: query has < 2 relations OR candidate has < 2 relations (v4 focuses on relation triples)
fraction of typed relations (relation_type != PLAIN) in query < 0.1

abstention.rationale: Abstention when relation extraction is too sparse or no structural correspondence found.

admission.sample_sources: the query texts of the first 8 groups in frozen split order (same as parent)

baseline_to_beat.target: beat band_control 0.506 confirmatory exact accuracy, AND B3_shuffled_gold advantage CI must contain 0

revival_strategy.primary_lever: relational-correspondence with M1 Progressive Relational Abstraction parent
revival_strategy.hypothesis: Second-order relation-triple alignment (capturing how relations connect typed roles) will capture analogical structure that flat typed-role/relation features miss, leading to higher confirmatory accuracy while preserving the v3 property that B3 advantage ~0.

hard_falsifier_ordering.description: B3 (shuffled-gold negative control) runs FIRST. If B3 fails again (advantage CI does not contain 0), STOP at NEGATIVE__BATTERY_FAILED with measured artifact. Never run confirmatory gates with a failed battery.
hard_falsifier_ordering.stop_condition: If B3_shuffled_gold g1_fails_as_required == false, TERMINAL at NEGATIVE__BATTERY_FAILED__INSTRUMENT_NOT_PROBATIVE

evaluation.scoring: same Brier scoring, same bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples, seed 20260814), same G1/G2/G3 gates as parent protocol

terminals: NEGATIVE__CAPABILITY_ABSENT (B3 passes but fails to beat band_control)
nonclaims: independent review (same-context analysis over third-party labels)
